inclusion_rule: Studies in the wiki first public before 2013-11 (index year, else manifest date; every 2013 item checked by month, one with an unresolved month excluded) whose full text names an intracranial recording (ECoG, intracortical, sEEG, Utah or microelectrode array, single units, depth electrodes) and a speech unit (phoneme, vowel, consonant, syllable); the design of interest is whether analysis windows are aligned to the onset of each phoneme inside a produced word (phoneme events within words) or to the trial cue, stimulus or word or speech onset. Boundary: perception, review and mapping papers stay in the population (upper bound); versions merged by title; target and its duplicate folder excluded;
